rows.en: Not much time has passed since it was stolen. They're most likely still somewhere in this area.
Please, catch up to the enemy and take back the O Raiser...!!
Understood. I'll carry out the mission.
Please, bring 00 here with you.
With this equipment, even we would stand a chance of winning...!
Yes. And that's exactly why we must make sure this equipment gets back with us.
Hey... look!
Captain!! We're being pursued!!
So they've come...!! Don't fall behind! We'll shake them off!
No doubt about it! They're the ones who stole the O Raiser!
Right, let's hurry after them. We have to take back the O Raiser no matter what.
There they are!
Tch! They're still on our tail!
Don't look back! They'll catch up to us!
Wait!
Damn! The passage on the right leads outside!!
I won't let you get away...!
Look out! Something's flying at us from behind!
This way! Hurry.
Good! They went the opposite way!
Now we keep driving them into a corner...!!
Looks like they're just up ahead.
It seems we've been had.
Give up. You have nowhere left to run. Hand over the O Raiser quietly, and we won't harm you.
That, we cannot do.
What did you say?
We need this O Raiser too, whatever it takes. We can't hand it over, no matter what.
...So negotiations have broken down. Then we'll take it back by force...!!
Let's go!!
Obtained "O Raiser".
Mission complete. With this, I've gotten my power back.
Completed the quest "Retrieving the O Raiser".
...No good. They're nowhere to be found.
Shouldn't we be bringing 00 along at a time like this?
Everyone, I've been waiting for you.
Is it true that the enemy stole the O Raiser?
Yes...
Repairs on the O Raiser you all found in the Desert Cube some time ago were finally finished.
So, just as we tried to carry the O Raiser on a transport Ride Machine,
we came under attack by the enemy.
It seems the enemy had been waiting for the moment the repairs were done...
After that, the enemy apparently fled in here, into the "Hideout Cube".
So we'd like you all to use your strength to get the O Raiser back for us.
Understood. Commencing the mission.
We're counting on you.
What's this?
That key is the master key for the Hideout Cube.
With that key, you can open the locked rooms in this Cube.
Please, be sure to find the enemy and get the O Raiser back.
Hey! Look at that one!
Target confirmed. I'll eliminate it by force of arms.
That one... it's got the O Raiser!?

You lot!? How did you get here!?
I'll be taking back the O Raiser.

notes.note: Rows 13-66 are not referenced by Quest012.bla (the only script loading QuestEventMess012); they are an earlier version of this quest (old briefing at rows 5-15, chase, no-00 path). Speakers inferred from wording: 13/14/18 Maganac (18 = request when 00 is absent), 15 00.
22-26: the thieves (a subordinate and their 'Captain'), speaking politely among themselves; unreferenced, no name boxes. 28 rough party member (Ankh-style), 29 neutral party leader.

Unreferenced chase. 38 read as the party worrying the thieves will escape outside; 40/46/47/49 party (00), 33/34/42/44 thieves. 42 'something flying from behind' = the party's shots herding them the other way (46).
52 thief captain realising they were herded into a dead end; 53/57 00; 54/56 the thieves (polite), 55 party. 'Kaishuu' in 57 kept as 'take it back'.
Quest title from QuestMess#0.13 'Retrieving the O Raiser'; format follows earlier quest completion rows. Item name 'O Raiser' (no item-table entry; matches QuestMess/SkillName).
65/66: unreferenced no-00 path; rough speaker (Ankh-style), not recovered.

Quest012.bla Event001: MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N plays row N+1 (empty rows 67/87/122 confirm; content confirms). +67 Maganac (79) -> 68, +68 00 (10) -> 69, +69..+75 Maganac -> 70-76, +76 00 -> 77. 78 and 81-84 unreferenced: 78/82-84 Maganac (polite, handing over the key), 81 party.
Yoroshiku onegai shimasu = Maganac asking the party -> 'We're counting on you.'

90-103 and 107-120 are leader-variant blocks (89 and 106 are 00's own lines, first in each 15-row block); the final script only plays 00's lines, so the variants are unreferenced. Identical Japanese kept identical; 90 differs only by '!?'; 118 is the rough variant ('ze!').
Unreferenced; inferred the Ahead reacting to the pursuers (its line +120 follows). 'Kisama-ra' -> 'You lot'.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers from Quest012.bla (row = TextIdOffset+N+1): Maganac 68/70-76, 00 69/77/89/106, Ankh 88/104. Rows 13-66, 78, 81-84, 105 unreferenced (old quest version / alternate lines), speakers inferred. Leader blocks 90-103 and 107-118 unreferenced variants. Quest title from QuestMess#0.13. No new names.
